page.overview:
What is Broadbeams?

The Broadbeams were a clan of Dwarves who came from the Blue Mountains.

They were paired with the Firebeards, but each tribe had its own mansion. Tolkien, however, never specified if the Broadbeams lived in Nogrod or Belegost meaning that Azaghâl may have been the Father of the Broadbeams as he was King of Belegost. At the start of the War of the Dwarves and Orcs, the houses of the other Seven Fathers of the Dwarves were called upon by Durin's Folk. It is probable that Broadbeams were one of the houses summoned.
